methodology: Bounded remote-journey diagnostic, not balance clearance. Actual engine, trained Dedication Knight snapshots validated through real progression UI; L1/5/10, one fixed trial, five reused small worlds, starter plus two geographically spread functioning towns. Town fixtures relocate full-health/full-supply characters BEFORE journeys, not played arrival or free recovery during journeys. Town selection uses maximum minimum geographic distance from already chosen towns; no source or biome data. Farthest reachable published quest target, no hidden provisioning navigation. A* terrain foresight; fog observation before source inspection. Only known standalone/revealed shelter sources considered for detours; compare <=3 versus <=8 actual one-way moves, with doubled return budgets. Declined policy visits but refuses gathering. Camp at30; turn back above projected85 fatigue after retracing all outward movement and spending remaining carried supplies. Future combat/skill costs remain uncertain. Main-route moves and detour moves recorded separately. Remote means >=32 straight-line tiles from every functioning settlement. Access logs additionally report shortest actual route among three geographically nearest towns, not guaranteed globally closest route. Real combat, rest, camp, gathering, merchants and inn recovery. No companions, other Callings, natural player navigation, dungeon completion or whole-campaign balance. Geometry observations across levels/policies are correlated routes, not independent worlds. Combat RNG shifts after additional gathering/detours; CI comparisons are descriptive, not causal. Per-world distinct site IDs prevent repeated trials becoming new exposure. Historical result artifacts are untouched.
